description:
The unsigned calldata to repay USDG debt: approve to Blue (when short) + repay(marketParams, usdg, 0, account, 0x), or for 'all'
        repay by the exact share debt (no dust; the approval carries 0.1% headroom for interest until the tx lands), with the post-action
        HF / LTV. nothing_to_repay, exceeds_debt, insufficient_balance are answers. Repay reads no oracle: it works while the oracle is
        unavailable. You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: borrow_repay_quote
